semiconductor_relevance: High — VX Instruments GmbH specializes in advanced test systems for power semiconductors, crucial for ensuring the quality and reliability of semiconductor devices.
summary: VX Instruments GmbH provides high-performance measurement instruments and test systems specifically designed for the power semiconductor industry. Their solutions are engineered for flexibility and reliability, supporting manufacturers in automotive, industrial, and renewable energy applications.
capabilities: Dynamic Semiconductor Testsystem DTS8765neo for power semiconductors
Automated test systems for characterization and production testing
Modular PXI platform for customizable testing solutions

regional_presence.Asia-Pacific: VX Instruments operates through its subsidiary in Singapore, providing local expertise and support to customers in the region.
